messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — high error rate (5xx) detected on model-runner-prod by metrics agent. Aggregated 5xx rate 18% over 2m window. paging on-call immediately :rotating_light:
ops-oncall: acked. paging @sara @miguel @priya. linking logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/tx/abcd1234
sara: I'm on it, looking at last 30m. seeing repeated \"Segmentation fault (core dumped)\" from model-runner container and some OOMs on node nv-gpu-3.
miguel: same. curl to /health returns 502 for several pods. can someone paste pod list?
priya: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-runner -o wide`
priya: output: `model-runner-7f9c8  CrashLoopBackOff  0/2  5m  10.128.1.32  nv-gpu-3`
sara: grabbing logs: `kubectl logs model-runner-7f9c8 -n inference --previous`
<sara pasted logs>:
```
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
  what():  std::bad_alloc
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
[2026-03-15T20:58:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4210 (model-runner) score 987
```
miguel: looks like a model allocation spike causing OOM then segfault. maybe a long input prefix or runaway batch size.
priya: recent deploy?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout model-runner v2.13 -> v2.14 at 2026-03-15T20:42Z by @ci
alex: I saw a canary yesterday with a change to kv-cache prefetching. could be related.
sara: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle concurrency, 2) route traffic to fallback smaller model, 3) restart affected pods, 4) cordon node nv-gpu-3 to avoid more OOMs.
miguel: I'm going to scale down replicas to drain traffic from model-runner-prod: `kubectl scale deployment/model-runner --replicas=0 -n inference` then bring up rollback variant.
priya: executing routing switch to fallback via internal API now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -d '{"route":"/generate","model":"redwood-mini-8bit","weight":0.9}'
```
priya: routing change submitted, shifting 90% traffic to fallback model.
customer-success-bot: FYI affected customers with elevated errors in last 10m: acct_2034 (AcmePay), acct_8812 (StudyAI), acct_5521 (LexaSearch). CS opened tickets and contacted top accounts.
sara: cordoning nv-gpu-3: `kubectl cordon nv-gpu-3` -> done. draining heavy pods.
miguel: started rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-runner -n inference --to-revision=27` -> in progress.
ops-oncall: updating status page: `Incident: Model runtime 5xx due to OOM/segfault on model-runner-prod. Mitigation: traffic shifted to redwood-mini-8bit, affected pods cordoned and rollback initiated. Customer impact: selective 5xx on generation endpoints. ETA for full recovery 20-30m.`
priya: monitoring metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4% after routing move. latency increased for fallback but within SLO for non-critical tiers.
sara: adding gateway throttle for long requests: enforce `max_input_tokens=4096` at edge and drop >1M token sessions.
alex: also capturing core dumps and coredumpctl output to /var/lib/incidents/1967890123. ENG-RUNTIME please triage allocator vs kernel OOM.
eng-runtime: acknowledged. assigning to @ken for deep dive.
ken: will reproduce with long-prefix stress test and inspect allocator patterns. grabbing core dumps now.
priya: handoff to night oncall @priya in 30m. I'll own the remainder and the postmortem.
priya: ack, I'll keep monitoring and collect diagnostics (gdb backtraces, coredumpctl list, `nvidia-smi` history).
sara: notes saved in incident doc, including commands run and links to logs.
ops-oncall: incident status -> Mitigated. followups: postmortem, alert tuning for kv-cache prefetch/large-batch protections, and adding a preflight check in deploy pipeline to block risky kv-cache changes. tagging: eng-runtime, eng-ml, ops, devex.
customer-success-bot: CS update posted to affected customers at 2026-03-15T21:10Z.
priya: handing off to night shift. leaving runbook notes and all commands in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
priya: closing active coordination here. will reopen thread if regressions occur.
